label: R23 PILOT/DEVELOPMENT; BF-SHG; FIT training, CAL selection, DEV pilots; no TEST
authorization: User 2026-10-26 forwarded R23 plan (registration under local structural inconsistency); main session fixed open design choices in the package brief.
hypothesis: With the same representation and budget, the original J (exact product-reference moments, unit-cosine critic) may favour broadly supported but imperfect shared structure over sparse highly discriminative local cues more than a well-tuned NCE does; under local geometric inconsistency this could give clearly better global rigid registration. Motivation verified numerically (binary rho=0.9 factor vs 15%-coverage 1024-value factor: sup J 0.25392 vs 0.21887, JS 0.14234 vs 0.15064, InfoNCE-128 0.491 vs 0.862); a joint representation keeps both (sup J 0.42472), so the effect, if any, depends on finite capacity and optimization.
task: Recover the global rigid T* that governs most of the image while a minority of the moving (SHG) image is locally deformed; V_obs = V o phi^-1 o T*^-1; error = host corner error vs T*; strict<9, loose<42, core macro.
critic_and_reference: T = u.v with unit descriptors; P = matched positions, Q = within-crop empirical product (train.py); unchanged for every objective.

objectives.soft_nce: symmetric soft-target CE, targets proportional to exp(-|x_i-x_j|^2/(2 sigma^2)) over the crop positions (512-scale px), logits cos/tau
objectives.bce: balanced BCE, logit a*cos+b, a,b learnable (init 2, 0), P diagonal, Q off-diagonal within crop
objectives.rince: RINCE (Chuang et al. 2022) on s=cos/tau: -exp(q s+)/q + (lambda (exp(s+)+sum exp(s-)))^q/q, lambda 0.01, symmetric

descriptor.dual: same encoder on the crop and on avg_pool2d(crop, 2); sample fine at x and coarse at (x-0.5)/2 (same physical point); concat -> Linear(32->16, no bias, init [I|I], trained with the encoders, weight decay as encoders) -> L2 normalize; identical interface for every objective

training: from scratch with the long-v2 seed-1001 encoder init (hash asserted); crop 256, 512 positions per crop uniform in [33, 222] (valid for both scales, same positions for all arms), n_sc 16; host sampler stream (seed 1001) shared by all arms; AdamW (weight decay 1e-4 on encoders/fusion, 0 on BCE a,b), clip 1.0; 10000 steps, LR base until step 5000, x0.1 until 8000, x0.01 until 10000. 'aug': each crop independently deformed with probability 0.5 (SHG crop, 1-2 disk regions covering 15% of the crop, amplitude 8 px), RNG seed_of('R23-AUG|bf|seed'), identical for every aug arm; 'clean': none. The learner sees only nominal pairs.
deformation: phi(x) = x + sum_k A w(|x-c_k|/r) e_k, w(rho)=0.5(1+cos(pi rho)) for rho<1 else 0; 1 or 2 non-overlapping disks (prob 0.5 each) of total area f; e_k random unit vectors; inverse by fixed-point iteration (A pi/(2r) < 1 asserted); eval instances per (core, perturbation) from seed_of('R23-DEF|core|i'), regions inside the common valid disk, applied to V in its native frame before the host perturbation.

conditions.occlude: instance regions of the moving image set to the robust median (0 after the clean normalization), region mask carried through the same perturbation
conditions.deform: main: f = 15% of the valid disk, A = 8 px (512 scale)
conditions.sparse_only: only the instance regions kept, complement set to the robust median (sparse structure decides the pose)
conditions.note: occlude/sparse_only use the clean normalization statistics because a filled image has a degenerate IQR; deform uses the host robust norm of its own image

evaluation_domain: common valid domain from the dual-scale receptive field with the host formula (RF_BOX 34): R_OMEGA 104, BOX1 [117,394], BOX2 [66,445]; every model (single- and dual-scale pilots, long-v2 references) evaluated on it with the host position rng (4096 positions), grid (21 x 508), top-3 starts, 100 Adam steps lr 0.5, host u = theta*RHO parameterization (RHO, UMAX unchanged); COS readout; new results are not compared with historical numbers on the old domain.

cal_selection.runs: 21, all dual + aug, seed 1001, 10000 steps: vcs_exact lr {1e-4,3e-4,1e-3}; nce tau {.03,.07,.15,.30} x lr {3e-4,1e-3}; soft_nce sigma {4,8} x tau {.07,.15} at lr 3e-4; bce lr {3e-4,1e-3}; rince q {0.1,0.5} x tau {.07,.15} at lr 3e-4
cal_selection.cal_eval: CAL (8 cores x 10 perturbations) under deform and clean at step 10000
cal_selection.rule: per family maximize (CAL deform strict, -CAL deform median error, CAL clean strict, -lr); families vcs, nce_control (= nce and soft_nce together), bce, rince; LOCK.json written before any DEV read

pilots.P4: best NCE control dual aug (selected CAL run)
pilots.references: long-v2 30k vcs_exact and nce seed 1001 re-evaluated on the new domain and conditions (descriptive)
pilots.dev: DEV (32 cores x 10 perturbations) under clean, occlude, deform, sparse_only at the fixed step-10000 checkpoint; auxiliary strengths for P3/P4

primary: DEV strict success under deform, P3 - P4 (pp), core macro, single seed (pilot, method-selection evidence only)
secondary: loose success, median, p90, p95 per condition
region-wise support: mean over positions of s(x; T*) - s(x; T* + (0, 5.66, 5.66)) inside vs outside the instance regions, offline from generator masks
expansion_rule: P3 - P4 >= +3 pp strict on DEV deform with p95 not worse: then only P3 and P4 get 30000-step runs and seeds 1002/1003 (separate package). Otherwise report and stop this line or redesign explicitly.
hardware: --partition=RTX6000PRO,L40S,H100 --exclude=node51,node53,node60, normal QOS, GPU recorded per run; single-seed pilots are not hardware-matched
limits: single seed; DEV reused development data; position search non-deterministic (0.6-2.2 pp re-evaluation noise on BF)
synthetic local deformation; natural data (ANHIR) only after a BF signal
10000-step pilots; a still-improving method is not judged at a truncated point
no_retry: failed attempts are kept and reviewed, never silently rerun
